description: This bar chart, titled “Targets,” illustrates the number of datasets categorized as either “Untargeted” or “Targeted” across each year from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the Year, labeled sequentially from left to right, while the vertical axis represents the “Number of datasets,” scaled linearly from 0 to 160 with tick marks at intervals of 20. Each year is represented by a stacked bar, with the lower portion colored blue indicating “Untargeted” datasets and the upper portion colored orange indicating “Targeted” datasets, as defined in the legend. The values for each segment are approximate: for 2012, the blue segment is approximately 1 dataset and the orange segment is approximately 1 dataset; for 2013, the blue segment is approximately 1 dataset and the orange segment is approximately 1 dataset; for 2014, the blue segment is approximately 1 dataset and the orange segment is approximately 1 dataset; for 2015, the blue segment is approximately 1 dataset and the orange segment is approximately 1 dataset; for 2016, the blue segment is approximately 5 datasets and the orange segment is approximately 10 datasets; for 2017, the blue segment is approximately 15 datasets and the orange segment is approximately 15 datasets; for 2018, the blue segment is approximately 20 datasets and the orange segment is approximately 25 datasets; for 2019, the blue segment is approximately 15 datasets and the orange segment is approximately 45 datasets; for 2020, the blue segment is approximately 45 datasets and the orange segment is approximately 80 datasets; for 2021, the blue segment is approximately 65 datasets and the orange segment is approximately 95 datasets; and for 2022, the blue segment is approximately 10 datasets and the orange segment is approximately 25 datasets. The bars are arranged chronologically along the x-axis and are not sorted in any particular order. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their color-coded segmentation.
